mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of quarters with positive GDP growth acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 3%, it signals strong demand that will support higher equity prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of months when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals an improving labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >40% of 3-month periods with UNRATE declines > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 10%, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a slowdown in residential investment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of months when HOUST YoY growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth (year-over-year percent change) is negative for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag down S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth is negative for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of 2-month periods with consecutive negative RSAFS YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months and payroll employment growth is negative, it signals a weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of 3-month periods with UNRATE rising > 0.3pp and negative PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (year-over-year percent change) is positive and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a supportive monetary policy for an expanding industrial sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: early-cycle expansion with easy monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of months when INDPRO YoY growth is positive and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
